input.quote: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: Section 13.1, the grant for the Services, licenses Customer alone and expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors with no mechanism to add them, and states the licence is revocable at Vendor's sole discretion — walk-away territory under this rule. Section 13.2's perpetual, irrevocable grant covering Affiliates and contractors is limited to paid-up software/Vendor Technology and embedded Deliverables, so it does not cure the Services grant, and Section 13.3 (transfer to Affiliate/successor plus revocation only for material uncured breach after notice and cure) addresses transferability and revocation but not Affiliate/contractor use. The fallback (affiliates covered, at least on written notice) is therefore not met. Minimal edit extends 13.1 to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and ties revocation to the notice-and-cure standard already agreed in 13.3; successor transfer is already covered by 13.3 so no further change is needed.

proposal.summary: Extend the Services licence in 13.1 to Affiliates and contractors and remove revocation at Vendor's discretion
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Services licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our playbook requires operational use by those parties and Section 13.1 currently excludes them with no path to add them. We also aligned revocation with the notice-and-cure limits already agreed in Section 13.3 rather than Vendor's sole discretion.

ops.oldText: Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a non-transferable licence, revocable only as provided in Section 13.3, to use the Services.
